data.summary: The Bußgeldstelle (municipal traffic enforcement office) of Stadt Musterau issued a fine notice (Bußgeldbescheid) dated 18.05.2026 to Jonas Mustermann for exceeding the speed limit by 23 km/h outside a built-up area on 30.04.2026, imposing a total of €98.50 and 1 point in the driving register (Fahreignungsregister).
data.explanation: This is an official notice finding you responsible for a speeding offense (Verkehrsordnungswidrigkeit). You have the right to file a written objection (Einspruch) with the Bußgeldstelle by the deadline shown, which is counted from the day the letter was actually delivered to you (a formal delivery certificate, Zustellungsurkunde, confirms this). If you do not object in time, the decision becomes final (rechtskräftig) and can be enforced. Once final, the total amount of €98.50 is due within two weeks and should be transferred to the account shown, using the case number (Aktenzeichen) as payment reference. If you think the measurement is wrong or want to contest it, consider consulting a traffic lawyer (Verkehrsanwalt) before the deadline passes.
